issue.body:
# Description
The following code crashes X86 backend with "LLVM ERROR: Unsupported library call operation!"

# Minimal Reproduction
https://godbolt.org/z/M6WE541vK

## Code
```
@G.1 = global bfloat 0xR7F80

define void @f(fp128 %x) {
  %CastFPTrunc = fptrunc fp128 %x to bfloat
  store bfloat %CastFPTrunc, ptr @G.1, align 2
  ret void
}
```

comments.author: phoebewang
comments.body: This is very similar to adding support for FP80, just replace `truncxfbf2` with `trunctfbf2`. See https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/109143

issue.title: [X86-backend] fptrunc fp128 %x to bfloat failed!
